The @ifrc is actively supporting the Philippines Red Cross as Typhoon Kalmaegi ripped through central Philippines from 3-5 November 2025 with destructive winds and torrential rain causing widespread flooding and landslides, including in the area hit by a deadly earthquake just over a month ago.

Overall, approximately 2 million people have been affected across nine provinces, with more than 430,000 people displaced. With @IFRC support, staff and volunteers from @philredcross have been crucial in preparedness and response, rescuing people stranded by floodwaters, and providing first aid, hot meals, safe water and welfare services in evacuation centres.

This is what trusted local presence looks like - and why it matters.

Local action saves lives.

🎙️ RYS Weekly Updates & Chills – EP16 Recap

✨ Highlights from this week:

🔹 Crypto Market 

It’s a good Friday. Bitcoin just dipped around $100k, something we actually predicted in spaces. Alts are down too, and since February we’ve all been wondering what’s next. It's hard to tell, but this cycle feels different. Still, the best move right now is to do nothing. Crypto isn’t going anywhere. Just hold your conviction plays.
 
🔹 23,000+ Active Users 

 We've had 23,000 active users this week, and that's up 17% despite the shitty market. Also, the spike in the Philippines and Indonesia has actually been great. It's great to see you guys in here. Out of the 23k we had this week, 15k were new users. 

🔹 500k Users Milestone 
 
This week, we did break 500k total users, which is a very great milestone if you're judging by the fact that the platform was launched about 9-10 months ago. Before the token was launched, we had about 115k users overall on the platform, and then after the launch of the token, we grew exponentially (over 400k in the period that the token has been around).

🔹 Staking Growth
 
About 3.3m of $RYS token were staked this week. Over the course of 3-6 months, and the total supply we currently have staked right now is about 61.9% of the total supply, and it's amazing to have that much more amount staked.

✨Updates

🔹 Buybot Update

Our raiders and mods are now earning directly through our automated payment system, a feature we’ve been building for a while. It’s already live for RYS team members, and we’re expanding it to the public soon so raiders and mods can get job alerts and automatic payments from developers based on their work and getting these jobs should be easier using the credibility of the name RYS.

🔹 Community Collaboration 

We’ve been focusing on community collaborations to help more people discover what we’re building and how our utilities can support their growth. The conversations have been great. We even joined a collab space this week and spotted a few of you there. Big shoutout to you all!

🔹 Community-score System

This kind of works differently from the raiding system because we are working on it so that each task you perform will give you points, and each point is gonna reward you in RYS or SOL, but you're going to be rewarded for each task you do. So, basically, you're gonna get rewarded for working for your bags, and RYS gives you an opportunity to be able to do that, and you don't have to be a raider, you just have to engage and be a part of the community.

❓ Community Q&A :

Q: Why do you have the safe burns turned on?

A:  Someone accused us of being a scam because of the Safe Burns feature, so here’s a quick clarification. Mistakes happen. People sometimes burn tokens or collectibles by accident. Safe Burns protects you from that. When it’s on, your tokens aren’t sent to an inaccessible wallet right away. If you realize you made a mistake, you can contact us via the RYS bot on Telegram or open a ticket on Discord, and we’ll recover your tokens at full value. We recommend keeping Safe Burns on, but you can turn it off if you want your burn to be permanent.

 Over the course of the week, we're gonna educate people more on it and also tutorials are on our youtube channel.

🔗: https://t.co/tdWUi1NMMW

🔥 That’s a wrap for this week. Stay positive, stay engaged, and let’s keep building together.

🎙️ Recorded Version: https://t.co/GqfOCyhLyL

AWARENESS AND SHARING PRAYERS FOR EVERYONE’S SAFETY 

Everyone, please stay alert and keep safe! 

PAGASA has released Impact-Based Warning No. 2 for Tropical Cyclone “UWAN”, which is expected to bring heavy rainfall and possible flooding over Metro Manila from November 9–10, 2025 (Sunday to Monday).

⚠️ Significant impacts are expected, including possible damage to homes and facilities, power interruptions, and travel disruptions. Let’s all prepare early, follow safety reminders, and stay updated through official sources.

💧 Stay indoors during heavy rain.
⚡ Avoid floodwaters and electrical hazards.
🚫 Don’t cross or drive through flooded areas.
🕯 Keep emergency supplies ready.
🙏 Let’s pray for everyone’s safety, especially those in affected areas.

Stay safe, stay informed, and let’s continue to look out for one another. 

#StaySafePH 
#PERAYA #BABII #POLCA

Our fellow Filipinos are still recovering from the devastation caused by Typhoon Tino just a few days ago, with widespread flooding and a rising death toll. Now, another powerful storm, Typhoon Uwan (Fung-Wong), is approaching the Philippines. It’s nearly as massive as the entire country and is rapidly intensifying.

Please stay indoors when possible, avoid flooded areas, and keep yourself updated through official government channels. Prepare your Go Bag Kit and be ready for any emergencies.

If you or someone you know needs help or rescue assistance, please reach out to your local authorities. You may also drop a comment or send us a DM, we’ll do our best to help connect you to the right contacts.

Girlfreens, let’s come together and use our platform to support one another.
Stay safe, stay dry, and stay alert.

#UwanPH #FungWong #RescuePH
